traps: the Python project and the front-end npm package are both named mealie, so the units are referred to by root: . and frontend; tests/e2e is a third package named e2e that only holds Playwright
Vite is not a direct dependency: Nuxt builds with it, and the front end declares only the plugin @vitejs/plugin-vue for its Vitest config
docker/docker-compose.yml starts only the mealie image with DB_ENGINE sqlite; PostgreSQL and Mailpit are in docker-compose.dev.yml

SMTP, LDAP and OpenID Connect are pydantic settings in mealie/core/settings/settings.py, enabled only when their variables are set; tests/e2e/docker/docker-compose.yml starts mock-oauth2-server and OpenLDAP for them
AI providers are rows in the database since a 2026 migration; the openai package is the only client declared
notifications go through the apprise library, and paho-mqtt is declared for it: the targets are user URLs, not services of the project
only frameworks and services are measured; the other facets are in unknown
